title: Levels media placeholder
description: A plain token-coloured surface standing in for media until a real one is passed in: near-black for app screens and film, a mid grey for photos, or a faint sage and green wash for charts. It fills the box it is given.
notes: size, radius and shape come from the parent or className
film stays dark in dark mode
name: levels-placeholder

props.name: tone
props.description: film: near-black (app screens, video) · photo: mid grey · wash: faint sage and green (charts)

props.name: label
props.description: what the slot will hold, read to screen readers (e.g. "App screens")
